note: The deprecated global port option creates the default listener before later listener-specific settings are parsed.
Switching on per-listener security after the default listener exists changes the meaning of subsequent listener options.
The parser only rejects the mode switch when security options were already attached, so a mixed default/non-default listener configuration can slip through.
A later non-default listener is then added under the new per-listener mode, creating the mixed listener set that triggers the bug.

Listener startup allocates and initializes per-listener security state for each listener; the mixed default/non-default configuration can leave the listener array inconsistent and crash during startup.
